description: PASS: streaming API response reassembled from Server-Sent Events (SSE) delta chunks before digest computation. The model-produced domain is the reassembled JSON object. The transport-delivered domain is the stream of delta chunks as they crossed the wire. The digest is computed over the reassembled form — the transport domain is not reproducible by a third-party verifier, but the model-produced domain is. This vector demonstrates that the transform table (stream-reassemble) is declared with a stable identifier so any divergence between the wire bytes and the pre-image bytes is attributable to that transform rather than treated as a substitution.

domain_transforms.description: Reassemble a stream of SSE delta chunks into a single JSON object by concatenating the 'chunk' field of each item in arrival order. The final chunk carries 'done: true'. The concatenated string is parsed as JSON to yield the target-domain object. This transform is deterministic given a complete stream.
